notes:
Call and Settings Fixes + Guest Badge

  • Mute indicator visible to everyone. When you mute yourself in a call, the red microphone-slash badge now also appears on your bubble for everyone else (not just you).
  • Bubble video effect persists. Switching your bubble to black-and-white (or any visual effect) no longer gets reset when you open Settings and click Save.
  • Calendar connection self-heals. If the calendar session silently expires, the app now clears the stale credentials and prompts you to reconnect, instead of pretending to be connected. Logging out also fully disconnects the calendar.
  • Guest badge for external members. Team members whose email doesn't match your company domain now get a small Guest badge next to their name in the lobby sidebar and in Settings → Team Members.
  • Accurate cursor during full-screen share. When you share your full screen on a Retina or high-DPI display, the cursor your teammates see on your monitor now lines up with their actual pointer instead of drifting away.
  • Plus internal improvements to the development workflow (no end-user-visible change).
